title: Record-setting January peak
summary: Thai gold moved above THB 80,000 per baht-weight during an exceptionally volatile final week of January.
reported_factors: Reporting pointed to the global gold rally and strong safe-haven demand; the domestic price also reflected USD/THB conversion.

title: First-half reversal
summary: Global gold fell from an intraday January peak above USD 5,500/oz toward—and briefly below—USD 4,000/oz in late June.
reported_factors: The World Gold Council discussed shifts in risk and uncertainty, opportunity cost, economic conditions, and momentum rather than a single cause.

title: Lowest official monthly average of 2026 through September
summary: The official Thai gold-bar selling-price monthly average was THB 64,603.57 in July, the lowest monthly average in the published January–September series.
reported_factors: The same official table shows a lower global spot average than earlier months and a weaker baht per US dollar than in January; these are co-moving inputs, not proof of causation.

title: Sharp October daily decline
summary: Thai bullion closed at THB 65,600 per baht-weight after 21 price announcements, down THB 650 from the prior close.
reported_factors: The report cited global spot-market selling pressure, a stronger US dollar, and baht fluctuations.
